verdict.rationale: Fireflies provides a built-in Apollo Sandbox at api.fireflies.ai/graphql where users can introspect the schema and run authenticated queries. Its docs add per-query reference pages and an examples section with code snippets, including Replit-hosted runnable examples. missing for 10: evidence that the reference pages themselves embed 'try it' runnable consoles, breadth of runnable examples beyond the Replit mention, independent or hands-on corroboration of the sandbox experience.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: For introspection using our builtin Apollo Sandbox, visit api.fireflies.ai/graphql and enter your api_key in the Headers section as a Bearer token
Introspection is a feature that allows querying a GraphQL server to discover its schema.
Explore a wide array of examples where we have created code snippets that allows you to interact with the Fireflies API.
This replit allows you to query questions asked by participants who do not belong to your organization.
